meta.attribution: Deep-sky positions, types, magnitudes and sizes from Stellarium nebulae/default/catalog.txt (Catalog Version 3.23 standard); English names from names.dat; Chinese names from Stellarium zh_CN.po translations of names.dat; constellation membership from data/constellations_spans.dat (ADC VI/42, Roman 1987).
meta.constellation_method: IAU constellation spans lookup (Stellarium getIAUConstellation / ADC VI/42); J2000 coordinates are precessed to B1875 with IAU 1976 precession before lookup. Labels only; positions near boundaries may be approximate.
meta.name_policy: English proper names only from names.dat; Chinese names only from zh_CN.po translations containing CJK. Never substitute an English name for a missing Chinese name; never invent names.
notes: M40 (Winnecke 4) is a double star in the source catalog (type *), not a nebula/cluster; render type double_star.
M102 is cross-indexed to NGC 5866 by the source catalog.
C+N entries are cluster+nebula systems; render type cluster_nebula.
Entries without a source proper name keep name_en/zh_name empty and are counted; their designation remains the label.
